title: A subterrain's regions (map/terrain/<folder>/regions.json)
description: The regions of war3map.w3r.json whose minimum corner (left, bottom) lies in this subterrain, read and written by crates/w3proj/src/terrain_objects.rs (docs/terrain-subterrains-spec.md, section 4). An entry is the flat file's entry (regions.schema.json) with an optional `order` first. The file's version lives in terrain.json's objects.regions, so the keys it needs aren't checked here. Other keys at the top are errors there, so they are refused here too.

order.description: its index in the flat file, where that isn't its place in this file's sorted order
